entities.summary: Rosendo Huesca Pacheco was a Mexican Catholic prelate. Born in 1932, he was ordained a priest in 1956. In 1970, he was consecrated bishop. He became Archbishop of Puebla de los Ángeles in 1977 and served until his retirement in 2009. Huesca Pacheco died at the age of 85 on 25 November 2017.
